# 0072: Every subagent is linked to the record that spawned it, or the fold stops

Status: accepted, 2026-10-17.
Extends [0033](0033-subagent-transcripts-are-captured-and-billed.md) (subagent transcripts are captured and billed) and [0056](0056-a-run-is-credited-with-its-subagents-work.md) (a run is credited with its subagents' work).
Extends [0065](0065-a-subagent-is-priced-at-its-own-models-rates.md), whose per-thread estimate each subagent now shows beside its span.

## Context

Subagents were found by globbing transcripts beside the session log.
A missing transcript directory meant no subagents, and a missing or unreadable sidecar was read as empty.
The spawning turn was matched by tool-use id on Claude and by timestamp on Codex, and an unmatched thread kept no turn at all.

Replaying a real sweep showed what that hid.
Sixteen Claude threads had been spawned by other subagents, not by the primary, so none of them had a spawning turn.
Codex writes its spawns in two shapes, and a fork replays its parent's `session_meta` after its own.
The fold kept the later one, so those forks were recorded under the primary's id.
Nothing recorded when a thread started or ended.

## Decision

**A thread is linked to its spawn, one to one.** Each harness reads every spawn record from every thread's log, the primary's and each subagent's, and reads each transcript's claim of who spawned it.
`harness/threads.py` pairs them.
Any other pairing raises `SubagentMismatch`, a `RunError`.
That covers a transcript no spawn names, a spawn with no transcript, and two claims on one spawn.
It also covers a transcript naming a parent that did not spawn it.
A spawn whose tool result reports a failure owes no transcript.

**Claude links by tool-use id.** A call to the `Agent` tool (or `Task`, its earlier name) is a spawn.
The transcript's `agent-<id>.meta.json` sidecar names the spawn's `toolUseId` and, for a nested thread, its `parentAgentId`.
The sidecar is required.

**Codex links by thread id or by path.** A code-mode `exec` completes a `CollabAgentToolCall` item naming each new thread in `receiver_thread_ids`.
A direct `spawn_agent` call is answered by an output naming the thread's `task_name`, which is the fork's `agent_path`.
A fork's own id is its first `session_meta`, and its parent is the `parent_thread_id` that record names.
The spawning turn is the turn whose records hold the spawn record's line, never a timestamp match.

**Each subagent records its link and its span.** `spawned_by` is the spawn record's id.
`parent` is the spawning thread, empty for the primary.
`depth` counts the threads between it and the primary.
`parent_turn` is the primary turn it descends from, where its work is credited.
`started_at` and `ended_at` are its transcript's first and last timestamps, and a transcript with none stops the fold.
`duration_ms` is the span.
`output_tokens_per_sec` is its output tokens over that span, because Claude can stamp every call's latency as zero.
Its `estimated_cost_usd` stays the cost at its own model's rates.

**A run that will not fold is kept, then failed.** The harness raises `UnfoldedRun`, a `RunError` carrying the run's evidence.
The cell copies the log and every transcript into the session directory before the error leaves.
It writes `unfolded.json` in place of `result.json`, holding the refusal and the keys a replay reads back.
The report skips that directory as a partial capture.
A replay retries it after every other session is rebuilt, and fails while it still does not fold.

## Consequences

A run with a subagent its evidence cannot account for no longer grades.
It stops with the mismatch named, rather than billing work it does not show or showing work it did not bill.
What it paid for is still on disk, so a fixed reader turns it into an ordinary result by replay.
Every link field is required, so a subagent never carries a guessed turn.

The session page shows each thread's span, duration, throughput, cost, model and place in the spawn tree.
A result written before this record says its span is not recorded, and a replay links it.

A new spawn shape in either CLI surfaces as a failed fold that names the thread.
The fix is one more shape in that harness's `spawns_in`.

## Lens

A subagent is evidence twice: the spawn its parent logged, and the transcript it wrote.
Count a thread only when both sides agree, and stop when they do not.
